# pyRANSAC-3D

> Python library for fitting 3D geometric primitives to point clouds with RANSAC.

pyRANSAC-3D is a Python library for fitting planes, lines, circles, spheres, cylinders, cuboids, and point clusters to 3D point clouds with RANSAC.

- [Auxiliary](https://leomariga.github.io/pyRANSAC-3D/api-documentation/auxiliary/index.md)

- [Fit Results](https://leomariga.github.io/pyRANSAC-3D/api-documentation/fit-results/index.md)
- [Fit State](https://leomariga.github.io/pyRANSAC-3D/api-documentation/fit-state/index.md)
- [Line](https://leomariga.github.io/pyRANSAC-3D/api-documentation/line/index.md)
- [Plane](https://leomariga.github.io/pyRANSAC-3D/api-documentation/plane/index.md)
- [Point](https://leomariga.github.io/pyRANSAC-3D/api-documentation/point/index.md)
